statement: Help home-improvement shoppers browse and search the catalog, evaluate and customize products, and complete pickup-based orders and account flows, obtaining a confirmed order and reviewable purchase history. The clone reconstructs the anonymous + account-holder shopping experience: browse/search the tool catalog, inspect and customize products, manage a pickup cart, complete a local-sandbox pickup order, and review account order history. No real card, real email, or external charge is accepted; place-order is clone-local with an explicit local-sandbox outcome. Payment/credential entry fails closed.
out_of_scope: Pro Xtra / B2B pricing program (materially different, not in 23-task scope)
Real payment capture, real card/wallet processing, live Stripe
Real transactional email / SMS pickup notifications
Full catalog beyond the milwaukee-18v-cordless-drill search set + Tools/Drills PLP first pages (data reduced per ruling; functional surfaces preserved)
Store inventory realtime, delivery scheduling calendar, installation services booking
